sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com), English. The host is not reachable from the build machine, so the text was read from the repo's own snapshot of the wiki pages (the .github/wiki folder: the attribute pages and the spell pages, intro and description) and from the search summaries of the live pages. Quoted facts are the wiki's; nothing was invented.
sources.design: Order and thresholds of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs and the strength of the spell: the sources give no chapter or episode for them. See docs/magic/character_spells_rest.md.

spells.name: Gravity Magic: Heavy Infighting
spells.note: He moves in and punches rapidly; gravity makes the fists heavier for damage and lighter for speed.

spells.name: Gravity Magic (added weight)
spells.note: Gravity Magic page: increasing gravity on a body part makes attacks deal more damage.

spells.name: Gravity Magic (lessened gravity)
spells.note: Gravity Magic page: decreasing gravity makes attacks and movement quicker.

spells.name: Gravity Magic: Heavy Infighting Gladiator
spells.note: A sword-based variant: he controls the speed of his sword strikes with gravity.

spells.name: Gravity Magic (slamming a target down)
spells.note: Gravity Magic page: greatly increased gravity slams a target into the ground.

spells.name: Gravity Magic: Presence of the Demon King
spells.note: A wide-area, high-intensity gravitational field that forces opponents to the ground and nullifies long-range attacks.

spells.name: Gravity Magic: Evil God's Pressure Craft
spells.note: Gravity lifts rocks and compresses them into a greatsword he controls with his hands and launches at a target.

spells.name: Gravity Magic (small black hole; the Gravity Singularity small form)
spells.note: The Gravity Singularity itself stays a forbidden ritual and is not a page; this is its small form.

planned.name: Gravity Singularity
planned.note: A small black hole that destroys everything in a short range: the book's forbidden ritual, never a page.

planned.name: Body Magic: Body Compression and his flesh
planned.note: His original attribute; the Body book is not his CanonBook entry.

notes: Gravity Well is this mod's own page and was not found in any source for Dante (kept in the basic Gravity book). Dante's gravity came from the devil Lucifero; his Body Magic was his own.
